items.title: Wild Discovery
items.description: A collection of documentaries that aired as part of Wild Discovery, a Discovery Channel nature documentary show that aired from 1995 to an unspecified date in the early-mid 2000s. The show featured syndicated documentaries—some of which had been broadcasted previously on the channel and
